text.text_excerpt: When I arrived the place was packed. I ordered a shrimp poboy to go and while it took a while to get it, it was not bad. The shrimp weren't pouring out, but it was still tasty. The people are super friendly there. They put everything on styrofoam plates though, that is bad! These are banned in most of CA now, very bad for the environment!

The staff was very nice even when I kept changing my mind about my orders. The food was great. I got the breakfast sandwich and the jambalaya plate and I will definitely get them again. I took a look at the kitchen area and it was not as horrible as some people have described on here. They also take credit cards so that can be helpful as well. I wasn't completely sure what to think of the place because of all the bad reviews regarding the cleanness of the place, however it was not bad at all! It's a diner so you can't compare it with hotel restaurants and who is to say nice restaurants are absolutely clean? You have to remind yourself it's a diner and it's not a huge tourist place to eat ...

We split a shrimp po boy and mac n cheese (made with spaghetti instead of macaroni) for under $11. Both were delicious and I'm not sure that I could've eaten that meal all by myself. It was a lot of food. The shrimp was perfectly cooked and not overbreaded and there were plenty of shrimp - no skimping here. The bread was crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. The mac n cheese was creamy and rich. The owner was so nice. We will def be back the next time we visit NOLA.
